From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Hannah / Marissa — quick answers below; happy to jump on a quick call if helpful:

1) API subscription: supports tenant-only incremental exports via our /v1/logs/subscribe endpoint. It returns an initial window (configurable start_time) and keeps a stream (server-sent events) for live forwarding. For contract SOW language, say: "Push (customer S3), ad-hoc export (pre-signed archive), or authenticated API subscription with incremental streaming."

2) Default redaction/tokenization: we apply the following defaults on exported audit logs (applies to both push and ad-hoc export):
   - email_address: retained but tokenized (hash) by default
   - ip_address: last-octet masked by default (e.g., 10.0.0.1 -> 10.0.0.X)
   - ssn/national_id patterns: redacted entirely
   - request_body PII flags: structured fields flagged by ML redaction are redacted unless customer requests full raw export via an audit waiver process

Customers may request custom redaction profiles; these are implemented via a support ticket and a short change window (typically 2 business days for configuration + validation). We do not alter the canonical system logs (retained for internal compliance), but exported tenant-level slices are processed through the redaction pipeline before delivery.

3) SLA for 90-day slice: standard turnaround is 2 business days for exports up to 10M events; larger exports scoped with customer ops (we can commit to a target of 5 business days for >10M events). Format: we provide JSONL by default, CSV on request. For chain-of-custody needs we can include a manifest and a SHA256 digest file.

I attached a small sample JSONL snippet (10k sample) and a one-page matrix for inclusion in the SIG response.

Rishi
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

Hi Oliver —

Thanks for the patience. Please find the concise answers below and two attachments (redwood-log-subscription-matrix.pdf and auditlog-sample-20261021.jsonl). Summary:

- Delivery models: Push to customer S3 (customer provides bucket + optional cross-account role), pre-signed archive export (time-limited link), authenticated API subscription (incremental + SSE for live).
- Redaction & tokenization: default rules (email -> hash, ip -> last-octet mask, ssn -> redacted). Customers can request custom profiles via support (typical config + validation 2 business days).
- SLA for 90-day slice: 2 business days for requests <=10M events. For larger windows we engage Customer Ops and provide a committed schedule (typically <=5 business days). Exports are delivered as JSONL by default; CSV on request. Includes manifest + SHA256 digest if requested for audit chain-of-custody.

If FinBank needs a written SOW clause, we can provide suggested language and an escalation path for emergency evidence requests (24-hour incident window with additional fees). Happy to hop on a call to walk through the matrix if that helps.

Best,
Hannah
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
